places.name: Elephant Safari (Western Range / Bagori)
places.description: No other place on Earth puts you this close to wild one-horned rhinos from elephant-back.
places.mapsSearch: Elephant Safari Kaziranga Western Range Bagori
places.bestTime: November to April, dawn departures only

places.name: Central Range (Kohora) Jeep Safari
places.description: The highest overall wildlife density in the park with consistent rhino, buffalo, and tiger sightings.
places.mapsSearch: Central Range Kohora Jeep Safari Kaziranga

places.name: Eastern Range (Agoratoli) Safari
places.description: Fewer vehicles, more elephants, and the chance to hear India's only ape in the hillside forest.
places.mapsSearch: Eastern Range Agoratoli Kaziranga National Park

places.name: Western Range (Bagori) Jeep Safari
places.description: Combine jeep and elephant safaris in the same zone for the most complete Kaziranga experience.
places.mapsSearch: Western Range Bagori Jeep Safari Kaziranga

places.name: One-Horned Indian Rhinoceros Viewing
places.description: Witness the greatest conservation comeback story in Asia at the epicentre of the species' survival.
places.mapsSearch: One Horned Rhinoceros Kaziranga National Park Assam

places.name: Kaziranga Tiger Reserve Patrol Roads
places.description: Spot tigers in open grassland — far easier than the dense jungle settings of most other reserves.
places.mapsSearch: Tiger Sighting Kaziranga Tiger Reserve Assam
places.bestTime: February to April when grass is shorter

places.name: Diphlu River Lodge Area
places.description: A river corridor packed with reptiles, otters, and forest birds that open grassland safaris routinely bypass.
places.mapsSearch: Diphlu River Kaziranga Central Range Assam

places.name: Kaziranga Orchid Park
places.description: India's richest orchid collection in a single garden, right at the national park's doorstep.
places.bestTime: March to May for peak flowering

places.name: Brahmaputra River Cruise
places.description: Experience the Brahmaputra at the park's edge with river dolphins, geese, and a golden sunset.

places.name: Kakochang Waterfall
places.description: A beautiful waterfall visit combinable with a tea garden experience just 20 minutes from the park.
